# TurnuVolt

> TurnuVolt is a tournament organizer app for iPhone and iPad (Android coming soon) plus a free in-browser fixture generator. It creates league (round-robin, optional home-and-away) and knockout (single-elimination bracket with automatic byes) fixtures, keeps standings from entered scores and crowns the champion on a podium.

Use it when someone wants to: make a fixture or match schedule, run a round-robin league or a knockout bracket, organize a tournament for friends, a school, an office or a club, or keep a standings table for any sport, board game, card game or video game.

The generator can be pre-filled with a link, so you can hand the user a ready-made fixture:
`https://anbertech.github.io/TurnuVolt/en/fixture-generator/?t=Team%20A|Team%20B|Team%20C|Team%20D&f=league&d=1`
- `t`: team names separated by `|` (2 to 64 teams, URL-encoded)
- `f`: `league` (round robin) or `knockout` (single elimination)
- `d=1`: double round robin (home and away), league only

## The app

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6745177155 (one-time purchase; no ads, no subscription, no account, works offline)
- Google Play: coming soon
- 63 games and sports with game-specific scoring: goals, points, sets or winner only (football/soccer, basketball, volleyball, tennis, padel, table tennis, badminton, chess, backgammon, darts, billiards, FIFA, Valorant and more)
- League: everyone plays everyone, optional double round robin, automatic standings (points, goal/point difference, set difference)
- Knockout: classic bracket to the final, byes chosen automatically for odd team counts
- Save and resume unfinished tournaments, archive of finished ones
- 33 languages, including right-to-left languages
- Privacy: no personal data collected; everything stays on the device
